description:
## Problem
The TPC-DS Q16/Q94/Q95 multi-warehouse rule and the distinct-count NULL fixes (PR #4169) are tested per DataFrame family in `tests/unit/core/tpcds/test_multi_warehouse_orders.py` (families pandas, dask, modin, cudf) and `tests/unit/platforms/dataframe/test_distinct_count_null_parity.py`. The modin and cudf cases `importorskip`, and neither package is installed in CI or locally: pyproject.toml has no modin extra, and `dataframe-cudf` needs an NVIDIA GPU. So those families' results under the fix are unverified.

## Method
- Modin: run both test files with `uv run --with modin -- pytest ...` (no lock change), on Modin's default execution engine, which must be stated; if it needs Ray or Dask, add that with `--with` too. Record Modin, engine and pandas versions and per-case outcome; confirm from the pytest output that the modin cases ran rather than skipped.
- cuDF: only on a GPU host the owner names; otherwise record as not run.

## Decision gate
- Modin passes: record and continue.
- Modin fails: fix in the Modin path (no platform-name branches in query code) in one PR, or, if Modin is unsupported by policy, ask the owner whether to drop the family from the test.
- No GPU host named: cuDF recorded as not verified; the owner decides whether that closes the item.

## Guardrails
No pyproject or uv.lock changes to add Modin without owner approval. No reference-answer changes. Heavy test runs via `make heavy-run`.
